notes: Shorthand notes from calls and internal threads. Product: customer support automation (agentic assistants that search KB + take actions in SaaS apps). Primary ask = low p95 streaming latency + reliable tool-call orchestration. Quote from Head of Product: "If the tool-call fails intermittently the assistant loses context and we get angry customers. We need deterministic retries and visibility." Interested in hosted path for quick time-to-value but likely move to Dedicated once SLA and predictable unit economics proven. Cost sensitivity: mid-market seat economics, cannot exceed $X per active agent monthly. Security: must support SSO, enterprise audit logs, KMS; data residency discussion for EU customers. POC notes: reproduce timeout under load, exercise fallback policies (model-variant, region), measure end-to-end latencies on streaming + tool calls. SE and Maya running daily standups for POC.
poc_scope: Hosted API streaming demo: single-agent, 100 concurrent simulated users
Multi-step workflow: search KB -> call CRM API -> update ticket -> confirm action
Measure: p50/p95 token latency, end-to-end action latency, tool-call success rate
Introduce automatic retries and explicit timeout configuration; test fallback to passive responses
workload_summary: Agentic chat assistants that need search + action pipelines. Typical sessions 6-12 steps; average message length 20-120 tokens; peak concurrency 80-150 agents per region. Sensitive to jitter during tool calling. Requires streaming responses and function/tool calling support.
latency_targets: p95 token stream latency < 200ms; end-to-end action (search + API update) < 700ms ideally; tool-call RT < 300ms with >99% success under POC load
commercial_notes: Procurement prefers annual commit if Dedicated price reduces unit cost by >=30%. Asking for sample SLO language for dedicated SLA. Wants usage-based hosted pricing for initial 3 months while validating.
